definition: Giant panda; the iconic black-and-white bear native to south central China and national treasure of the country.
composition_note: 熊 (bear: 能 néng + four dots 灬 symbolizing paws/fur) + 猫 (cat: radical 犭 animal + phonetic 苗 miáo imitating a cat's purr/meow). Literally: 'bear-cat' (panda). Measure word: 只 (zhī).

example.es: A los pandas les gusta comer bambú.
example.fr: Les pandas aiment manger du bambou.

note: Classifier for pandas: 一只熊猫 (yì zhī xióngmāo = one panda). Considered China's national treasure (国宝 guóbǎo).
